nodes.question: What sampling method was used to collect the soil cores during the study?
nodes.answer: A custom-made drill for undisturbed sampling of cylindrical soil cores encased in a stiff 5 mm PE sleeve was used.

nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How do simplified cropping systems affect soil quality?
nodes.answer: Simplified cropping systems may degrade soil quality due to losses in soil organic carbon and nitrogen.
